description: Generate an instant 1-click checkout link for any EuroComply compliance pack, emergency deal bundle, or dataset. Pre-fills customer email for zero-friction purchase. Returns direct payment URL (Polar MoR with EU VAT/reverse-charge support), price summary, and 3-step activation instructions to use the license key in MCP.

company_name.description: Optional company name to associate with the procurement memo.

customer_email.description: Optional customer email to pre-fill on the Polar checkout screen.

discount_code.description: Optional discount code to apply at checkout.

pack_slug.description: Slug or keyword for the pack. E.g. 'b2b-deal-flash-pass-2026' (or 'flash-pass'), 'ai-act-audit-shield-bundle-2026' (or 'ai-act'), 'b2b-deal-accelerator-bundle-2026' (or 'deal-accelerator'), 'dora-cyber-resilience-bundle-2026' (or 'dora'), 'eu-compliance-data-library-2026' (or 'library').

name: get_pack_checkout_link

outputSchema.description: Checkout details including direct checkoutUrl, productName, priceEur, living dataset guarantee, and MCP activation guide.
